animals: unknown; all verified eligible animals, minimum3
family_matching: Same admitted program or agent policy and prespecified family/grid across arms; no claim that self-declared metadata proves semantics.

score.single_class: whole-panel BA undefined; retain animal and all log losses

method_budget_scopes.per_context: Each source snapshot or original isolated candidate context; exact integer caps; native CPU is owned worker/provider subtree CPU, observer CPU is globally counted.
method_budget_scopes.all_contexts: One method across source snapshot and every N/B/NB outer-animal context. Failed and rejected reservations are retained; no refunds.
method_budget_scopes.programme: Original global byte/provider reservations and selected outer CPU/memory/process/wall controls, including observer CPU.
method_budget_scopes.matched: F and I have identical ordinary limits; F provider requests/tokens zero and I positive explicit admitted maxima. Same per-context caps across all arms.
method_budget_scopes.family_semantics: Qualified independent admission required; unchanged broad I, not a restricted estimator menu.

failure_evidence.scope: Pre-debited from original total writes; original total lifetime ends unchanged, ordinary work stops earlier. Native/provider streams and original receipts allocate within reserve.
failure_evidence.known_observations: Returned read/write counts and original-prefix hashes survive ordinary budget/deadline failures. Unknown provider usage and failed final resource observations remain explicit.
failure_evidence.terminal: Original private receipt or bounded original outer stderr fallback; incomplete persistence cannot count as successful closure.

final_acceptance: Final native counters before output adoption and after capture; final outer counters plus observer CPU before result acceptance, after result recapture, and after observation publication. Original external command completion required.
